title: Comfort, ride quality, and design impressions
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on favorable impressions of comfort, responsiveness, quietness, braking feel, and styling, with many other fragments describing vehicle traits without clear sentiment and one specific complaint about cupholder design.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise comfort, quietness, responsiveness, braking feel, and elegant exterior design.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention dissatisfaction with the design of the door-panel cupholders.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe attributes such as build, speed, ride plushness, smoother driving, stability, and appearance, but the supplied labeling does not support a clear sentiment summary beyond those observations.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are labeled undetermined even when they describe seemingly favorable or unfavorable attributes, which limits how much of the topic can be cleanly summarized by sentiment.
The topic combines several aspects, including ride comfort, driving dynamics, build impression, and styling, rather than a single tightly focused issue.
Only sampled fragments are available here, and the sample is stratified rather than representative.
